description: RBF SVM applies the kernel trick to map TF-IDF-derived dense features into a higher-dimensional space where a linear separator may exist. C controls the margin/loss trade-off; gamma controls kernel width. Variant of the SVM family (see models/svm/config.json).
input_features: Dense TruncatedSVD (100 components, training-fold fitted) of word unigram/bigram TF-IDF. SVD is a feature transform, not a classifier, and is fitted on training data only.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/svm/rbf/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + svd.joblib + metadata.json).
